UserAppData.title: UserAppData
UserAppData.description: Root user state encompassing tasks, transactions, budget, exams, habits, notes, and VTU academic profile.

tasks.description: List of user tasks and subtasks

transactions.description: List of income and expense transactions

budget.description: Monthly budget and savings target settings

exams.description: Exam schedule, study guides, and topics

habits.description: Habit trackers with streaks and completed dates

vtuProfile.description: VTU student profile with SGPA, attendance, and scheme details

masterPlan.description: Optional AI-generated or custom master study plan

lastUpdated.description: Epoch millisecond timestamp of the last modification

/users/{userId}.description: Private user root document holding all application data isolated strictly to the authenticated owner
